collection.description: A woman asks another woman to the lantern festival, and an elder mistakes them for sisters.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A woman asks another woman to join her at the lantern festival. A well-meaning elder mistakes them for sisters.

choices.label: Invite the elder to meet her partner

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The elder blushes, apologizes, and later saves them two seats together.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The elder asks awkward questions but listens and offers a sincere blessing.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: They enjoy the festival privately and decide for themselves whom to tell.

b__text.text: They enjoy the festival privately and decide for themselves whom to tell.
